body: CI all green at b4d294e803. One fix since the first READY: CI's test time budget failed the bundle test (56.7s for three collector passes). The collector now runs once; for diff.renames false/copies the test asserts that the collector's own diff-tree call (diff_tree_args, extracted unchanged) returns the same bytes. Budget entry 45s. Local check-ci-fast stopped at 'Check aida-cli without default features': the cargo wrapper refuses to build because the target disk is at 14.3G, below the 15G floor ('cargo reap --apply' suggested; I did not run it, since it touches shared caches). The operator should decide on disk cleanup. Needs an independent review; mandate code (C5). Note: the current mandate expires about now.
